audit_metadata.target_application: EmirIT PC Building Simulator Root-Cause Resolution
audit_metadata.evaluation_standard: Reset Lifecycle, Strict Validation Gate, Label Standardization, Accessibility

test_cases.description: Verify that clicking 'Reset Simulation' properly restores draggable='true' and full dragstart/drop capability on Step 1 (Motherboard).
test_cases.findings: Global event listeners remain permanently active. resetSimulation() resets State.currentStepIndex to 0, clears State.installedComponents, resets all chassis slot classes, and calls updateGuidanceUI() which immediately restores draggable='true' and .active-target to the Motherboard.

test_cases.description: Verify invalid drops for RAM, RTX 4060, SSD, or Motherboard do NOT advance the active step.
test_cases.findings: validateAndSeatComponent() enforces explicit boolean check isCorrectSlot = (droppedId === targetSlotComponent && droppedId === currentExpected.id). When false, error feedback and audio buzz trigger immediately, returning out of the function without incrementing currentStepIndex.

test_cases.description: Ensure the user can attempt incorrect placements repeatedly without breaking state or skipping steps.
test_cases.findings: CSS shake-error animation reflows on demand ('void element.offsetWidth'), error toast displays 'Incorrect slot, try again', and user stays on the exact active step until placing the right component.

test_cases.description: Ensure all component and slot labels use exact simplified strings: 'Motherboard', 'PSU', 'RTX 4060', 'RAM', 'SSD', and 'Case'.
test_cases.findings: Verified across HTML cards, slot titles, action text, topbar branding, JS step configurations, modal summary pills, and descriptions.

test_cases.description: Verify mobile hamburger toggle on pc-builder.html functions properly to open and close main navigation.
test_cases.findings: bindMobileNavigation() added in pc-builder.js with click toggle, aria-expanded state handling, and Escape key dismissal.

test_cases.description: Verify tab navigation and keyboard activation (Enter/Space) on components and slots.
test_cases.findings: Added tabindex='0' to all chassis slots and bound Enter/Space keydown events on component cards to trigger placement.

test_cases.description: Verify completion state after Step 5 (RTX 4060) reveals modal and illuminates power status.
test_cases.findings: Chassis power LED turns green, status updates to 'POWER: ACTIVE (100% POST)', and completion modal displays with victory chime and reset option.
